objective: Independent, read-only shadow test of the formulation lead's proposed classsep prose-precision patch (artifacts/formulation/proposals/classsep_prose_precision_patch.md) against that proposal's own acceptance criteria, plus adversarial over-suppression probes and the formulation lead's stated next_falsifier for the growing CLASSSEP hard count.

pins.map_pin_policy: snapshot research_map/research_map.json to snapshot/research_map.pinned.json at run start; record its sha256 in snapshot/MANIFEST.json and bind all map measurements to that snapshot. The live map is under concurrent controller ingest; live-map drift is reported, not used.

pre_run_observations: Live map moved from 11311ab36005 (worker-085 pin, ~00:47) to 6d3f0f2792a2 (00:49:26) before this run; the moving target is the reason for the snapshot pin policy.
The formulation lead reported the G-AUDIT CLASSSEP hard count growing 9 -> 10 -> 17 and named classsep_prose_precision_patch.md as the fix (lead-form-20260912T004611-05).

pre_registered_expectations.E1_baseline_corpus: canonical detector on the 27-fixture worker-07 corpus: 17/17 leaks detected, 10/10 controls clean, FP=0, FN=0 (sanity baseline).
pre_registered_expectations.E2_shadow_corpus: shadow detector on the same corpus: 17/17 leaks detected, 10/10 controls clean, FP=0, FN=0 (patch acceptance criteria #1 and #2).
pre_registered_expectations.E3_declared_fp_probes: each of the 4 false-positive probe strings in the proposal produces 0 findings under the shadow detector (acceptance criterion #3a).
pre_registered_expectations.E4_declared_tp_probes: each of the 2 true-positive probe strings in the proposal produces >=1 finding under the shadow detector (acceptance criterion #3b).
pre_registered_expectations.E5_live_claim_drop: under the shadow detector every claim named in the proposal (claims[36,94,96,97,101,112,127,144] at the proposal's map revision) drops to 0 CLASSSEP findings (acceptance criterion #4). Record residuals with exact claim ids; do NOT assume this passes.
pre_registered_expectations.E6_adversarial_over_suppression: 6 pre-registered genuine merge assertions that merely co-occur with a _META word in the same sentence (case, test, corpus, independent, pattern, 'not the case ... separate') are expected to be SUPPRESSED by the shadow detector, i.e. 6 new false negatives relative to canonical. Recorded as a hazard of the proposal as written; falsified if the shadow still fires on them.
pre_registered_expectations.E7_growth_probe: 3 synthetic realistic 'analysis about the detector' claim statements (no explicit prohibition/split wording) added to a map copy: canonical delta >= +1; shadow delta <= canonical delta. Exact per-probe values recorded, not assumed.
pre_registered_expectations.E8_declaration_parity: on a 10-string declaration-mode battery the shadow detector's output is byte-identical to canonical (patch is prose-only; no scope creep).

falsifier: This shadow test is falsified by: (a) any on-disk pin mismatch at run start; (b) the shadow module differing from the canonical module by anything other than the patch's insertions; (c) a measured claim in this file that does not reproduce from snapshot/ + run_shadow_test.py; or (d) the canonical detector or the map snapshot moving before the run and the run citing a stale hash.
stop_rule: One run of the pinned instrument plus one report; no canonical-file edits, no rule changes after seeing results, no gate verdict. Exit after checkpoint.
